أستنكح (form X)
# أَسْتَنْكِحُ (ʔastankiḥu) /ʔas.tan.ki.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْكَحَ (istankaḥa)
# أَسْتَنْكِحَ (ʔastankiḥa) /ʔas.tan.ki.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْكَحَ (istankaḥa)
# أَسْتَنْكِحْ (ʔastankiḥ) /ʔas.tan.kiħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْكَحَ (istankaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
